name: Carinthiasuchus
sum: Carinthiasuchus is a small early-diverging poposauroid pseudosuchian with paired and then single tail osteoderms, from the Partnach Formation of Austria.
wsnote: The preserved skull portion is about 53 mm; adults were likely larger; no body length.
holotype: Nockalm 7030u, a limestone slab with parts of the skull, caudal vertebrae and a distal part of the tail in articulation.
biology: The tail bore a series of paired and then single bony plates (English Wikipedia).
author: Dalla Vecchia and Cau 2026

sources.text: Dalla Vecchia, F. M. and Cau, A. 2026. Carinthiasuchus kandutschi, a new archosaur (Reptilia: Diapsida) from the Triassic of Austria. Rivista Italiana di Paleontologia e Stratigrafia 132(2): 409-430.

dates_note: No PBDB occurrences. Ladinian to early Carnian per English Wikipedia; the ICS Ladinian-Carnian range is used.
